sentences.text: Tetangga Andi bekerja sebagai kasir di minimarket ujung gang.
sentences.en: Andi's neighbor works as a cashier at the minimarket at the end of the alley.
sentences.ko: 안디의 이웃은 골목 끝 편의점에서 계산원으로 일해요.

sentences.text: Dewi membayar tiket masuk museum kepada kasir yang ramah.
sentences.en: Dewi paid for her museum ticket to a friendly cashier.
sentences.ko: 데위는 친절한 계산원에게 박물관 입장권 값을 냈어요.

sentences.text: Andi meminjam lensa kamera dari tetangga sebelah untuk memotret pernikahan sepupunya.
sentences.en: Andi borrowed a camera lens from the neighbor next door to photograph his cousin's wedding.
sentences.ko: 안디는 사촌 결혼식 사진을 찍으려고 옆집에서 카메라 렌즈를 빌렸어요.

sentences.text: Dewi mengamati serangga kecil di bawah lensa pembesar.
sentences.en: Dewi examined a tiny insect under a magnifying lens.
sentences.ko: 데위는 돋보기 렌즈 아래의 작은 곤충을 관찰했어요.

sentences.text: Bu Ratna di depan rumah Andi mengaku pernah datang ke seorang cenayang untuk mencari kucingnya.
sentences.en: Mrs. Ratna across from Andi's house admits she once went to a psychic to find her cat.
sentences.ko: 안디네 집 앞 라트나 아주머니는 고양이를 찾으려고 점쟁이에게 간 적이 있대요.

sentences.text: Pemandu bercerita kepada Dewi tentang cenayang istana yang konon bisa meramal panen.
sentences.en: The guide told Dewi about a palace psychic who could supposedly predict harvests.
sentences.ko: 가이드는 데위에게 수확을 점칠 수 있었다는 궁중 점술가 이야기를 해 줬어요.

sentences.text: Andi bersyukur semua tetangga di gangnya hidup akur.
sentences.en: Andi is grateful that all the neighbors in his alley get along.
sentences.ko: 안디는 골목 이웃들이 다 사이좋게 지내서 감사해요.

sentences.text: Dewi senang melihat dua kakak beradik yang akur membaca keterangan pameran bersama.
sentences.en: Dewi was pleased to see two siblings getting along, reading the exhibit labels together.
sentences.ko: 데위는 사이좋은 남매가 함께 전시 설명을 읽는 걸 보고 흐뭇했어요.

sentences.text: Andi kesal dengan tetangga munafik yang memuji di depan tetapi bergosip di belakang.
sentences.en: Andi is annoyed by the two-faced neighbor who praises people to their faces but gossips behind their backs.
sentences.ko: 안디는 앞에서는 칭찬하고 뒤에서는 험담하는 위선적인 이웃에게 짜증이 나요.

sentences.text: Dalam pameran wayang, Dewi melihat tokoh munafik yang selalu berganti pihak.
sentences.en: In the puppet exhibition, Dewi saw a two-faced character who always switches sides.
sentences.ko: 와양 전시에서 데위는 늘 편을 바꾸는 위선적인 인물을 봤어요.

sentences.text: Pak Joko, bujangan di rumah sebelah, sering memasak terlalu banyak dan membaginya kepada Andi.
sentences.en: Mr. Joko, the bachelor next door, often cooks too much and shares it with Andi.
sentences.ko: 옆집 총각 조코 씨는 음식을 너무 많이 해서 자주 안디에게 나눠 줘요.

sentences.text: Dewi membaca surat-surat cinta seorang bujangan dari zaman kolonial.
sentences.en: Dewi read the love letters of a bachelor from the colonial era.
sentences.ko: 데위는 식민지 시대 한 총각의 연애편지를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Anak tetangga memanggil ibunya bunda, dan Andi menganggap itu manis sekali.
sentences.en: The neighbor's child calls his mother "bunda", and Andi finds it very sweet.
sentences.ko: 이웃집 아이는 엄마를 '분다'라고 불러서 안디는 그게 참 귀엽다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Seorang anak kecil menarik tangan ibunya dan berkata, "Bunda, lihat kapal itu!" di dekat Dewi.
sentences.en: Near Dewi, a little child tugged at his mother's hand and said, "Mom, look at that ship!"
sentences.ko: 데위 근처에서 한 아이가 엄마 손을 잡아끌며 "엄마, 저 배 좀 봐!"라고 했어요.

sentences.text: Seluruh warga gang melayat ketika kakek Andi wafat bulan lalu.
sentences.en: The whole alley came to pay respects when Andi's grandfather passed away last month.
sentences.ko: 지난달 안디의 할아버지가 돌아가셨을 때 골목 주민 모두가 조문을 왔어요.

sentences.text: Dewi membaca bahwa sang pelukis wafat sebelum karya terakhirnya selesai.
sentences.en: Dewi read that the painter passed away before his last work was finished.
sentences.ko: 데위는 그 화가가 마지막 작품을 끝내기 전에 세상을 떠났다는 글을 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Pagar rumah Andi sudah miring setelah ditabrak motor tetangga.
sentences.en: Andi's fence has been leaning since a neighbor's motorbike crashed into it.
sentences.ko: 이웃의 오토바이가 들이받은 뒤로 안디네 담장이 기울어졌어요.

sentences.text: Dewi memberi tahu petugas bahwa salah satu bingkai lukisan terpasang miring.
sentences.en: Dewi told the staff that one of the picture frames was hanging crooked.
sentences.ko: 데위는 직원에게 그림 액자 하나가 비뚤게 걸려 있다고 알려 줬어요.

sentences.text: Rumah tua di samping Andi dibangun oleh buyut tetangganya.
sentences.en: The old house next to Andi's was built by his neighbor's great-grandfather.
sentences.ko: 안디네 옆 오래된 집은 이웃의 증조할아버지가 지은 거예요.

sentences.text: Dewi menemukan foto buyut yang ikut membangun gedung museum itu.
sentences.en: Dewi found a photo of her great-grandfather, who helped build the museum building.
sentences.ko: 데위는 박물관 건물 짓는 데 참여한 증조할아버지의 사진을 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Andi tidak mau menuduh tetangga tanpa bukti yang berdasar.
sentences.en: Andi doesn't want to accuse a neighbor without well-founded evidence.
sentences.ko: 안디는 근거 있는 증거 없이 이웃을 의심하고 싶지 않아요.

sentences.text: Kurator menjelaskan kepada Dewi bahwa tanggal arca itu berdasar pada hasil uji karbon.
sentences.en: The curator explained to Dewi that the statue's date is based on carbon testing.
sentences.ko: 큐레이터는 데위에게 그 석상의 연대가 탄소 측정 결과에 근거한다고 설명했어요.

sentences.text: Tangan Andi lengket setelah membantu tetangga membuat dodol.
sentences.en: Andi's hands were sticky after helping the neighbors make dodol.
sentences.ko: 안디는 이웃과 도돌 과자를 만들고 나서 손이 끈적끈적했어요.

sentences.text: Lantai dekat kafe museum terasa lengket karena tumpahan es teh.
sentences.en: The floor near the museum café felt sticky from spilled iced tea.
sentences.ko: 박물관 카페 근처 바닥이 쏟아진 아이스티 때문에 끈적거렸어요.

sentences.text: Rapat RT malam itu berlangsung sengit karena soal parkir mobil.
sentences.en: The neighborhood meeting that night got heated over car parking.
sentences.ko: 그날 밤 반상회는 주차 문제로 격렬했어요.

sentences.text: Dewi membaca tentang pertempuran sengit yang terjadi di kota itu pada masa lalu.
sentences.en: Dewi read about a fierce battle that took place in that city in the past.
sentences.ko: 데위는 옛날 그 도시에서 벌어진 치열한 전투에 대해 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Andi tahu Pak Joko orang yang berperasaan halus, jadi ia berhati-hati saat menegur.
sentences.en: Andi knows Mr. Joko is a sensitive person, so he was careful when he spoke up.
sentences.ko: 안디는 조코 씨가 마음이 여린 사람인 걸 알아서 지적할 때 조심했어요.

sentences.text: Dewi menyukai seniman yang berperasaan peka terhadap alam.
sentences.en: Dewi likes artists who are deeply sensitive to nature.
sentences.ko: 데위는 자연에 예민하게 반응하는 예술가를 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Tukang sudah memasang kerangka atap rumah baru di seberang rumah Andi.
sentences.en: The builders have put up the roof frame of the new house across from Andi's.
sentences.ko: 일꾼들이 안디네 맞은편 새 집의 지붕 뼈대를 세웠어요.

sentences.text: Dewi terpukau melihat kerangka paus biru yang tergantung di aula utama.
sentences.en: Dewi was amazed by the blue whale skeleton hanging in the main hall.
sentences.ko: 데위는 중앙홀에 매달린 대왕고래 뼈대를 보고 넋을 잃었어요.

sentences.text: Nenek di sebelah rumah Andi masih hidup independen walau usianya sudah lanjut.
sentences.en: The grandmother next door to Andi still lives independently despite her age.
sentences.ko: 안디네 옆집 할머니는 연세가 많은데도 여전히 혼자 힘으로 살아요.

sentences.text: Museum kecil itu dikelola oleh yayasan independen tanpa dana pemerintah.
sentences.en: That small museum is run by an independent foundation without government funding.
sentences.ko: 그 작은 박물관은 정부 지원 없이 독립 재단이 운영해요.

sentences.text: Andi dan tetangganya sepakat menanam bambu sebagai pembatas halaman.
sentences.en: Andi and his neighbor agreed to plant bamboo as a boundary between their yards.
sentences.ko: 안디와 이웃은 마당 경계로 대나무를 심기로 했어요.

sentences.text: Petugas meminta Dewi tidak melewati tali pembatas di depan lukisan.
sentences.en: The staff asked Dewi not to cross the barrier rope in front of the painting.
sentences.ko: 직원은 데위에게 그림 앞 차단 줄을 넘지 말라고 했어요.

sentences.text: Saat banjir, rumah Andi yang bertingkat menampung beberapa keluarga tetangga.
sentences.en: During the flood, Andi's two-story house took in several neighboring families.
sentences.ko: 홍수 때 2층인 안디네 집은 이웃 몇 가족을 받아 줬어요.

sentences.text: Gudang bawah tanah museum menampung ribuan benda yang belum dipamerkan.
sentences.en: The museum's basement storage holds thousands of items not yet on display.
sentences.ko: 박물관 지하 수장고에는 아직 전시되지 않은 물건이 수천 점 있어요.

sentences.text: Anjing besar di ujung gang suka menggonggong untuk mengintimidasi tamu Andi.
sentences.en: The big dog at the end of the alley likes to bark to intimidate Andi's guests.
sentences.ko: 골목 끝 큰 개는 안디네 손님을 겁주려고 짖곤 해요.

sentences.text: Patung raksasa di pintu masuk dibuat untuk mengintimidasi musuh, kata pemandu kepada Dewi.
sentences.en: The giant statue at the entrance was made to intimidate enemies, the guide told Dewi.
sentences.ko: 입구의 거대한 석상은 적을 겁주려고 만든 거라고 가이드가 데위에게 말했어요.

sentences.text: Andi memergoki anak tetangga memetik mangga dari pohonnya.
sentences.en: Andi caught the neighbor's kid picking mangoes from his tree.
sentences.ko: 안디는 이웃집 아이가 자기 나무에서 망고를 따는 걸 들켰어요.

sentences.text: Petugas memergoki pengunjung yang memotret dengan lampu kilat di dekat Dewi.
sentences.en: The staff caught a visitor near Dewi taking photos with a flash.
sentences.ko: 직원은 데위 근처에서 플래시를 터뜨려 사진을 찍던 관람객을 적발했어요.

sentences.text: Lampu hias di teras rumah Andi memancarkan cahaya hangat setiap malam.
sentences.en: The decorative lights on Andi's porch give off a warm glow every night.
sentences.ko: 안디네 현관의 장식등은 밤마다 따뜻한 빛을 내요.

sentences.text: Dewi kagum melihat batu permata yang memancarkan warna ungu di bawah lampu.
sentences.en: Dewi was amazed to see a gemstone glowing purple under the light.
sentences.ko: 데위는 조명 아래에서 보랏빛을 내는 보석을 보고 감탄했어요.

sentences.text: Rumah Andi menonjol di gang itu karena catnya hijau terang.
sentences.en: Andi's house stands out in the alley because of its bright green paint.
sentences.ko: 안디네 집은 밝은 초록색이라 골목에서 눈에 띄어요.

sentences.text: Di antara semua koleksi, topeng emas itulah yang paling menonjol menurut Dewi.
sentences.en: Of all the collection, Dewi thought the golden mask stood out the most.
sentences.ko: 데위가 보기에 모든 소장품 가운데 그 황금 가면이 가장 눈에 띄었어요.

sentences.text: Andi meremas kertas undangan arisan dengan gemas karena salah tanggal.
sentences.en: Andi crumpled the gathering invitation in frustration because the date was wrong.
sentences.ko: 날짜가 틀려서 안디는 계모임 초대장을 답답한 마음에 구겨 버렸어요.

sentences.text: Dewi meremas brosur di tangannya karena gugup sebelum memandu tur pertamanya.
sentences.en: Dewi squeezed the brochure in her hand nervously before leading her first tour.
sentences.ko: 데위는 첫 투어 안내를 앞두고 긴장해서 손에 든 안내 책자를 꽉 쥐었어요.

sentences.text: Andi menjadi pendengar setia ketika tetangganya mengeluh soal pekerjaan.
sentences.en: Andi is a loyal listener when his neighbor complains about work.
sentences.ko: 이웃이 일 이야기로 하소연할 때 안디는 늘 귀 기울여 들어 줘요.

sentences.text: Dewi menjadi pendengar dalam diskusi kurator tentang seni modern.
sentences.en: Dewi was a listener at the curators' discussion on modern art.
sentences.ko: 데위는 현대 미술에 관한 큐레이터 토론을 청중으로 들었어요.

sentences.text: Tetangga Andi adalah suporter fanatik yang memasang bendera klub di atap.
sentences.en: Andi's neighbor is a fanatical supporter who put the club flag on his roof.
sentences.ko: 안디의 이웃은 지붕에 클럽 깃발을 단 열성 서포터예요.

sentences.text: Dewi membaca tentang kolektor fanatik yang menghabiskan hartanya demi keris kuno.
sentences.en: Dewi read about a fanatical collector who spent his fortune on ancient krises.
sentences.ko: 데위는 옛 크리스 단검에 재산을 다 쓴 광적인 수집가에 대해 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Andi berterima kasih atas kemurahan hati tetangga yang meminjamkan mobil.
sentences.en: Andi thanked his neighbor for the generosity of lending him a car.
sentences.ko: 안디는 차를 빌려준 이웃의 너그러움에 감사했어요.

sentences.text: Museum itu berdiri berkat kemurahan seorang saudagar kaya, kata papan yang dibaca Dewi.
sentences.en: The museum exists thanks to the generosity of a rich merchant, said the sign Dewi read.
sentences.ko: 데위가 읽은 안내판에는 그 박물관이 한 부유한 상인의 후원 덕분에 세워졌다고 적혀 있었어요.

sentences.text: Tetangga Andi yang cermat selalu mencatat siapa yang meminjam alat-alatnya.
sentences.en: Andi's meticulous neighbor always writes down who borrows his tools.
sentences.ko: 꼼꼼한 안디의 이웃은 누가 연장을 빌려 갔는지 늘 적어 둬요.

sentences.text: Dewi kagum pada kerja cermat para ahli yang merestorasi naskah kuno.
sentences.en: Dewi admired the meticulous work of the experts restoring ancient manuscripts.
sentences.ko: 데위는 옛 필사본을 복원하는 전문가들의 꼼꼼한 작업에 감탄했어요.

sentences.text: Pak Haji di sebelah rumah Andi terkenal dermawan kepada anak-anak yatim.
sentences.en: Pak Haji next to Andi's house is known for being generous to orphans.
sentences.ko: 안디네 옆집 하지 아저씨는 고아들에게 후하기로 유명해요.

sentences.text: Nama-nama penyumbang dermawan terukir di dinding dekat pintu tempat Dewi berdiri.
sentences.en: The names of generous donors are engraved on the wall by the door where Dewi stood.
sentences.ko: 데위가 서 있던 문 옆 벽에는 후한 기부자들의 이름이 새겨져 있었어요.

sentences.text: Andi tidak menyangka tetangga yang kaya itu ternyata pelit sekali.
sentences.en: Andi didn't expect the wealthy neighbor to turn out so stingy.
sentences.ko: 안디는 그 부자 이웃이 그렇게 인색할 줄 몰랐어요.

sentences.text: Dewi tertawa membaca kisah saudagar pelit dalam pameran cerita rakyat.
sentences.en: Dewi laughed reading the tale of a stingy merchant in the folklore exhibition.
sentences.ko: 데위는 민담 전시에서 인색한 상인 이야기를 읽고 웃었어요.

sentences.text: Ibu-ibu di gang Andi asyik membicarakan perselingkuhan tokoh dalam sinetron.
sentences.en: The women in Andi's alley were busy discussing a character's affair in a soap opera.
sentences.ko: 안디네 골목 아주머니들은 드라마 속 인물의 불륜 이야기에 푹 빠져 있었어요.

sentences.text: Dewi membaca bahwa perselingkuhan seorang bangsawan pernah memicu perang di masa lalu.
sentences.en: Dewi read that a nobleman's affair once triggered a war in the past.
sentences.ko: 데위는 옛날 한 귀족의 불륜이 전쟁을 일으킨 적이 있다는 글을 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Keluarga imigran yang baru pindah mengajari Andi memasak roti pipih.
sentences.en: The immigrant family that just moved in taught Andi to cook flatbread.
sentences.ko: 새로 이사 온 이민자 가족이 안디에게 납작빵 만드는 법을 가르쳐 줬어요.

sentences.text: Satu ruangan menampilkan koper-koper tua milik para imigran yang tiba lewat pelabuhan.
sentences.en: One room displays old suitcases belonging to immigrants who arrived through the port.
sentences.ko: 한 전시실에는 항구로 들어온 이민자들의 낡은 가방들이 놓여 있어요.

sentences.text: Andi menegur anak tetangga yang nekat memanjat tiang listrik.
sentences.en: Andi scolded the neighbor's kid who recklessly climbed an electricity pole.
sentences.ko: 안디는 무모하게 전봇대에 올라간 이웃집 아이를 나무랐어요.

sentences.text: Dewi membaca kisah pelaut nekat yang menyeberangi samudra dengan perahu kecil.
sentences.en: Dewi read the story of a daring sailor who crossed the ocean in a small boat.
sentences.ko: 데위는 작은 배로 대양을 건넌 무모한 선원의 이야기를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Tetangga Andi berharap putranya menjadi penerus usaha bengkel keluarga.
sentences.en: Andi's neighbor hopes his son will take over the family repair shop.
sentences.ko: 안디의 이웃은 아들이 가족 정비소를 이어받길 바라요.

sentences.text: Dewi ingin menjadi penerus kurator senior yang sebentar lagi pensiun.
sentences.en: Dewi wants to succeed the senior curator who is retiring soon.
sentences.ko: 데위는 곧 은퇴하는 선임 큐레이터의 뒤를 잇고 싶어요.

sentences.text: Remaja di sebelah rumah Andi menempel poster idola di jendela kamarnya.
sentences.en: The teenager next door to Andi stuck a poster of her idol on her bedroom window.
sentences.ko: 안디네 옆집 십대는 방 창문에 아이돌 포스터를 붙였어요.

sentences.text: Ada pameran khusus tentang idola musik pop tahun tujuh puluhan yang dikunjungi Dewi.
sentences.en: There was a special exhibition on pop music idols of the seventies that Dewi visited.
sentences.ko: 데위가 간 곳에는 70년대 팝 음악 스타에 관한 특별전이 있었어요.

sentences.text: Dulu sekelompok berandal sering nongkrong di pos ronda dekat rumah Andi.
sentences.en: A gang of hooligans used to hang out at the night-watch post near Andi's house.
sentences.ko: 예전에는 불량배 무리가 안디네 집 근처 야경 초소에 자주 모여 있었어요.

sentences.text: Dewi melihat lukisan tentang berandal pelabuhan yang kemudian menjadi pahlawan.
sentences.en: Dewi saw a painting about a harbor hooligan who later became a hero.
sentences.ko: 데위는 나중에 영웅이 된 항구의 불량배를 그린 그림을 봤어요.

sentences.text: Andi sering salah menyapa karena tetangganya punya kembaran yang mirip sekali.
sentences.en: Andi often greets the wrong person because his neighbor has a twin who looks exactly alike.
sentences.ko: 이웃에게 꼭 닮은 쌍둥이가 있어서 안디는 자주 사람을 착각해 인사해요.

sentences.text: Dewi membawa kembaran laki-lakinya ke museum untuk melihat pameran robot.
sentences.en: Dewi took her twin brother to the museum to see the robot exhibition.
sentences.ko: 데위는 로봇 전시를 보러 쌍둥이 남동생을 데리고 박물관에 갔어요.

sentences.text: Tetangga baru Andi adalah penyelam yang bekerja di proyek terumbu karang.
sentences.en: Andi's new neighbor is a diver who works on a coral reef project.
sentences.ko: 안디의 새 이웃은 산호초 사업에서 일하는 잠수부예요.

sentences.text: Seorang penyelam menemukan guci di bangkai kapal itu, kata keterangan yang dibaca Dewi.
sentences.en: A diver found the jar in that shipwreck, according to the caption Dewi read.
sentences.ko: 데위가 읽은 설명에 따르면 한 잠수부가 그 난파선에서 항아리를 찾았대요.

sentences.text: Andi menonton film sejarah tentang raja yang punya banyak selir bersama tetangganya.
sentences.en: Andi watched a historical film about a king with many concubines together with his neighbor.
sentences.ko: 안디는 이웃과 함께 후궁이 많은 왕에 관한 사극 영화를 봤어요.

sentences.text: Dewi melihat perhiasan milik selir raja di ruang pameran kerajaan.
sentences.en: Dewi saw jewelry belonging to the king's concubine in the royal exhibition room.
sentences.ko: 데위는 왕실 전시실에서 왕의 후궁이 쓰던 장신구를 봤어요.

sentences.text: Anak sulung tetangga Andi baru saja diterima di universitas.
sentences.en: The eldest child of Andi's neighbor has just been accepted to university.
sentences.ko: 안디 이웃의 맏이가 막 대학에 합격했어요.

sentences.text: Dewi adalah anak sulung yang selalu mengajak adik-adiknya ke museum.
sentences.en: Dewi is the eldest child and always takes her younger siblings to museums.
sentences.ko: 데위는 늘 동생들을 데리고 박물관에 가는 맏이예요.

sentences.text: Tetangga Andi yang suka mengutak-atik barang bermimpi jadi penemu terkenal.
sentences.en: Andi's neighbor who loves tinkering dreams of becoming a famous inventor.
sentences.ko: 물건 만지작거리길 좋아하는 안디의 이웃은 유명한 발명가가 되는 꿈을 꿔요.

sentences.text: Dewi membaca biografi penemu mesin cetak di ruang sejarah teknologi.
sentences.en: Dewi read the biography of the inventor of the printing press in the technology history room.
sentences.ko: 데위는 기술사 전시실에서 인쇄기 발명가의 전기를 읽었어요.
